name: North Alabama Pipeline (South System Expansion III Phase 2)
researcher_notes: Not in the roster: no row for the North Alabama line under Southern Natural Gas (only P0252 system and P7855 South System Expansion 4). Passes the add rules: sponsor is Southern Natural Gas Co, FERC certificate granted May 28, 1997 in docket CP96-153 for about 118 miles to serve Huntsville and Decatur, Alabama, and it was built (about 123 miles). Length well above the 25 km floor. EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 145, project 'SONAT SSEE III Phase 2': Completed 2000-01-15, Alabama, 123 miles, 12 and 16 inch, 75 MMcf/d added, cost 66.6 million (staged as 66600000 USD), docket CP96-153. The public Fortnightly summary of the 1997 FERC orders gives 118 miles for the certificated project; staged 123 mi as the later EIA figure, difference noted. The Fortnightly page does not state diameters or the project name used by EIA, and the full article is behind a login. Sources are not fully independent because EIA draws on the FERC filings, so tier is medium. The Phase 2 label in the EIA name looks like a mislabel: the separate South System Expansion III phases in the EIA table are 2010-2012 projects in other dockets (CP09-36). Start and end points are only known as Alabama; Huntsville and Decatur are the customers served, so exact endpoints were not staged. No route found; route type unavailable, accuracy no route. Owner 'Southern Natural Gas' matches the existing gazetteer entity exactly. A web search for a landowner news story returned a dead link, not used.
